items.quote: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me?
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses, asking why he cried

items.quote: speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward
items.claim: The children of Israel are commanded to go forward

items.quote: lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it
items.claim: The commanded actor will lift his rod and stretch his hand over the sea to divide it

items.quote: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea
items.claim: The children of Israel will travel through the sea on dry ground
